units.source_text: 过了十来天的一个午后，良平一个人站在工地上，远远望着矿车驶过来。

en.t: One afternoon about ten days later, Ryohei stood alone at the construction site, watching from a distance as the trolley came toward him.

units.source_text: 除了装土的矿车，还有一辆载着枕木的矿车，正沿着铺设干线用的粗轨往坡上爬。

en.t: Besides the trolleys loaded with earth, there was another trolley carrying railroad ties, climbing the slope along the heavy rails laid for the main line.

units.source_text: 两个年轻的工人正合力推这辆矿车。

en.t: Two young workers were pushing the trolley together.

units.source_text: 良平看着他们俩，觉得他们身上有一种平易近人的亲切感。

en.t: Watching the two of them, Ryohei felt that they had an approachable, friendly warmth about them.
